title: International territorial level 3, January 2025 (United Kingdom, generalised, clipped)
description: The finest tier of the ITL geography used for UK economic statistics, grouping local authorities into areas comparable across the United Kingdom. The 2025 revision renumbers and resplits much of the 2021 tier, so its codes are not interchangeable with it.

files.note: Exported from the Open Geography Portal feature service "ITL3_JAN_2025_UK_BGC_V2" (https://services1.arcgis.com/ESMARspQHYMw9BZ9/arcgis/rest/services/ITL3_JAN_2025_UK_BGC_V2/FeatureServer/1/query?where=1%3D1&outFields=*&outSR=4326&f=geojson), 182 features in WGS84. The portal serves this product through the API rather than as a named download, so the file is named for the layer and reproduced by rerunning that query rather than by filename. The whole layer exceeds one response, so the query is paged in resultOffset order with resultRecordCount=25 and the pages concatenated in that order, which keeps a re-download byte-identical while the publisher has not changed it.
